Procedural moral traps were dead: update() never ran in production and offer.trap never reached the active instance. Attach now rides offer generation; end-fork choices settle through missions' own abandon path; continue-forks mark rep now and pay at delivery.

World-anchored ship/station presentation animated on wall clock: kill-cam hard freeze, bullet-time, and the restore latch kept fans/plumes/damage/micro-motion/drills/death-spirals moving while the sim held. Closures now read simNow and the dt-block runs on the time-effects-scaled delta (landed inside keepout lane commit 4f102db53; contract pinned by test/pause-freezes-ship-presentation.test.mjs in 41bbba03a).

Holds-full sounded like a menu misclick (literal UI deny recipe), heat warning borrowed a combat countermeasure sample, mass-required borrowed a collision voice, and the rig stall refusal was silent in-mine. Dedicated mining recipes + authored-sample rebinds + drill:warn reason field route a stall whine and resume blip.

The Quiet's Mercenary Outpost in Io Reach was a label: a nav buoy, an empty zone, no berth. Now a dockable writ house (bounty board, blackmarket, minRep -30 quiet door), a standing-gated contracted-lance picket off-berth, and Sallow the Contract Broker in the bar.

Sker Haven had traffic (9/min) and a repGated bazaar but no named lane identity — the levy market's lanes were anonymous. Vey Senna, TITHE-RUN, now deterministic pick via ensureNamedLaneContact with a gimmick label; loc catalog regenerated.

Four authored encounters (botched procedure, wrong laugh, literalized drawer, customs logic net) were parked forever: only combat/civilian pressure pools existed and the pacing gate vetoes unfunded decks. Mystery banks in derelict/anomaly zones; patrol scales with security and cordons.

Bounty Wrecks was dressing plus a discovery line: no signal, no entity, no decision. It now emits a DERELICT SALVAGE signal, gates on active scan plus manual investigation, binds the hulk as the recovery body, and settles rescue/blackbox/strip through the existing recovery owner.
repulsor and clearing cone now teach on the first-hour rail like boost, stroke, and well
rated well+primed-light cluster moment now lands as a premium player receipt: banner, caption, camera, authored boom, detonation VFX; NPC clusters keep world lanes only

Five live K1-route factions (Archive/Fulfillment/Pitborn/Understory/Verge-Layer) spoke Frontier fallback words and voice on every contact; each house now authors its own bark corpus, recognition/law/event-line families, bar voice, stunt lines, and a distinct synthetic voice register (corpus 277->437, all WAVs generated, blind PCM identification green).

blackmarket was the only station type with no ambient-business side events, so every den's apron read commercially dead; the live side-event planner now schedules den business — an unmanifested lights-out runner (quiet_dock, new slip-run trajectory + dim accent) and the fence's cargo tractor.

Ghost on the Bearing carried authored bark/telegraph/primaryLine fields the ambush runtime never read — a choiceless stalk that sprang or timed out. It now opens a priced Quiet contract hail (12 s window): buy out for a flat 420 cr, hold the bearing and fight, or burn off and flee; broke pockets collapse to refusal through the shared assassination spring.

Reinforcement calls reached the player only at call time for authored callers; arrivals materialized silently (ai:reinforcementSpawned had zero subscribers) and the scheduled event dropped callerId, killing barkDirector's 'reinforce' seam via payload mismatch. Scheduled now names its caller so the live bark consumer speaks; the first member of each squad raises an annunciator line + toast on arrival; reaver_pirate's legacy-schema call gained a real packageId (reaver_swarm_screen) so the most common authored caller reaches the live route at all.

Ruined Cache Station — the tier-4 salvage sector's only berth — was the only blackmarket-type station missing the 'black_market' service token, so the Pitborn 'Yards and Fences' presence node derived an empty record and salvage-rights redemption refused with 'pitborn yard only' at the sector whose stunt loop mints them. One token revives the fence: presence derives 'fence', the Redeem verb pays out through the economy single-writer, and map labels agree with the station's own type.

The Mass Seed's lock-ring drew a ring but latched nothing: FIELD_DEFS.seed.lockStrength and the kernel's hitch-lock branch existed with no producer. A live seed now mirrors into an external kernel RING field tracking the hull, ring-entry edges latch hitches (rope-delivered bodies and drifting loose mass), re-roping a held body cuts the hitch, and the ring dies with the seed. Ships are never auto-caught — the ring is a parking tool, not a passive trap.

The Eris Margin Metronome was a charted:false scan label describing an 'area-denial emitter' that denied nothing — every operable machine lived in charted space. A rotating denial cone now registers in the field kernel on the saved 8 s sim clock, shoves mass mouth-first (NPCs take the shove — bait the patrol), burns the player through the combat kernel's hazard_radiation origin, and speaks hazard boundaries; a debris_current warning circle marks the approach.

The bounty board sold a hunt but delivered a slot machine: 'a wanted target' that materialized on an anonymous ring around the player — the one contract type whose fiction is a specific person never produced one. Generated single-mark bounties now roll a deterministic storyTarget (hash32 on seed+offerId, zero rng draws) naming a wanted-poster person at a named place (POI, lurk-able zone, or gate); the title, brief, and nav reason read like a warrant; the spawn table shares markArchetypePoolFor so the implied hull is honest; Continue-adopted marks get their person identity re-stamped; and the mark hails once on comms when the player closes inside scanner range.

Customs posts were checkpoint costumes: Customs Gate and Dione Customs advertise 'scan'/'toll' services with working-checkpoint chart fiction, but docking ran zero customs machinery — no hold read, no plate collected. The berth now runs the shipped runScan sweep on every dock (clean manifests get a line; exposed contraband resolves through the existing confiscate/fine/rep authority) and collects a security-scaled toll (50 + 200·sec) on the service:* receipt rail.

Hull insurance was a 500-cr purchase whose 60%-payout math lived in dead code and whose 'protect installed modules' copy insured a risk that does not exist — provably a no-op on the starter hull. recoveryCostQuote() now prices the active hull at purchase time; the service row and confirm dialog name covered credits, and the defeat toast reports the real numbers (Pelican 6,000 → 500; Hitch honest no-op).

enemies.js authored occasional/defensiveOnly mount flags that resolveEnemyWeapon stripped, making every special secondary an always-on primary. The flags now survive spawn resolution and gate in the live fire service: reaver/jackal missiles arrive as a seeded lock-to-launch spike inside a deterministic sim-time window (lock warnings re-arm per window), EMP/plasma burst in windows, and cornered flak answers only inside its own close envelope. AI intent unchanged.

barks.js authored a complete distress situation for all 13 registers (52 dying-transmission lines) but BARK_SITUATIONS never listed it and no death path existed — every NPC hull exploded in radio silence. entity:killed now routes through _speakVictimDistress: the victim keys open once with its register last line, gated to kills the player caused, player-hostile victims, or deaths inside the table authority radius so far-side attrition stays silent. BARK_EVENT_SITUATIONS keeps the generated-WAV index contract frozen; barkVoice normalization accepts the event set so a mayday is not laundered into a scan receipt.

Spontaneous market events now name a good the station actually trades — shortages and blockades hit its real inputs, surpluses its real outputs — and blockades cluster on faction war fronts while quiet high-security core berths stop crying piracy.

The trap's moment of truth now always lands mid-run — undocking presents the fork even on same-sector deliveries, and when a live law sweep catches you first the reveal becomes witnessed, speaking the trap's patrol line with the cutter alongside.

Ashfall's burn is now a real roaming storm: an 840 WU burn core circles the charted 2000 WU envelope on a deterministic 36 s law (pure simTime, save-stable), it vents for the same 7 s window the Lighthouse survey gate opens — gate.allowed === burn.venting, pinned across seeds — the burn's hazard enter/exit and damage follow the vented/roaring intensity, and a blocked Lighthouse ping finally speaks: 'The burn is roaring over the wreck — it vents in ~Xs. Time the ping.'

Ambush wings that declare terrain:'lee' (020 ambush_snare, 334 tether-control raider) now spawn behind the best rock on your approach bearing — cover between you and the wing, formation preserved, deterministic, fail-open when no qualifying rock exists.

A limping, non-hostile hull (hull at or below 85% of max) joins the mining beam's ordinary aim-biased scan and can be welded shut for credits under the same heat gauge — and the rope-and-weld is now wired on the default route: latched to a casualty, RMB/LT stays the mining beam (isThrowArmPayload no longer claims non-hostile ship/drone latches) so you latch, winch, and hold the weld to full; latched to a hostile, RMB still arms the throw exactly as before. The hull closing fires one cooled weld-out thanks.

The two west-march frontier sectors off the core (Hyperion Cut, Nyx March) now show one named working hull each — Ossa of the Cut Run running the claim ore, Nineola Hush running the Quiet's unlogged cargo — with target-panel gimmick labels; stamped through the proven traffic named-contact seam

Docking at the Charon Expanse hunter exchange now gives the player a named writ clerk (Ferrow) speaking hunter register, and the bar's rumor names the sector's real Snapped-Tether Hab-Pod distress site — a lead the writ wall does not pay for

Scanning/triangulating the three deep frontier anomalies (Resonance Obelisk, Orcus Signal, Wake Anomaly) now records an authored discovery plate in the exploration journal — the find finally tells you what it is instead of a generic triangulation line

Hailing an Io Reach or Ashfall hull no longer falls outside the contact system: faction_free and faction_vael get authored contact grammar (MUTUAL lean-share / CLAUSE accord-claim) bound to their live doctrines, plus sector-grounded register lines — the last two houses that spawned without contact words

The Ceres industrial chain now answers a real casualty honestly: once the tender actually recovers the hauler, the cathedral patrol runs a visible cover leg on the hauler's next delivery (fall_in/shadow/eye/handoff) — the world responding to what happened, watchable, joinable, spoilable; tenth chain link through the proven seam

Io Reach (the contested floor) gains storm + radiation-belt weather on the proven Veil/Vesta shape; shots bend in the debris current, POI scan shrinks in the belt
Dione Lane is the Concord:Vael war front; the south's systemic war (pickets, escort wing, front-kill momentum, active-front resolution) now reaches the southern run
Three authored Band landmark voices (Wreck Cathedral, Candle Fleet, Lung of Charon) were unreachable: the live sampler never fed their strength keys; now wired end to end

A Reach corsair now runs a pack of fused detonator darts on a leash through the ambush lanes: pay the weigh-off, run, or meet three-plus kamikaze bombs whose blasts ignore the roster — kill or shove one inside the pack and the formation chains.

Ordinary salvage contracts now land on a contested wreck: a claim crew is already cutting the dead hull when you arrive, so you can strip it under protest, wipe the crew first, tow the hull away, or let them load out and take the cargo back off their hauler.

Four sealed unique wrecks (Vigilant, Lighthouse, Choir-Bell, Cassandra) deliver authored rumors on sector entry; registry census 12/12 delivery paths was 8/12; Lighthouse beam 18000cr and choirVaelTreaty unlock reachable
Passenger offers mint a deterministic name + why-line, speak on boarding/mid-run/arrival, and the fugitive trap names the person hauled; 39 unique names across 264 seed-4242 boards
Denied countermeasure presses say why (event + alert) and missile telegraph slots carry the recharge sweep + JAMMING duration; the defense verb exists at the threat
A resolved unique wreck keeps an outcome-stamped husk at its site (24 authored siteStamp lines); map bearings point at something real; handovers can never pay twice
Cargo traps require the hold's actual moral family, reveal timing follows route topology, and every resolved fork leaves a pending moralMemory debt behind
Bottom-center flight pills (planet/field/mass-seed) negotiate one lane by voice class; 22px text-through-text overlap gone, fourth voice can join collision-free
All 15 claimable bodies carry authored discovery plates and why-lines; arrival plate and claimed Base screen tell you what the place was

Four SP1 story chains run through authored placed wrecks (Quadrille/Double Entry/First Notch/Regular) instead of scanner pulses at empty space; recovery requires the bound hull
Witness-run settlement moves Dorin/Kell's contact counters through the seam that had zero emitters; bar greetings and voice bands change with what you did, clamped at authored maxes

Shipworks gains a paint rack: the shipped ship-appearance backend finally has a surface — 11 hull coats, 8 trims, 3 finishes, 4 wear grades, live on the stage and in flight, persisted with the hull
A refused cut now answers in the same Massline deny voice a refused latch does; it was mute before, so players could not tell the key registered

Open aftermath causes now lean the sector state itself - danger up, law thin, visible on the map dossier and felt by law/predation planners - and the remedy job visibly settles the sector again; a third failed remedy closes the wound
A sector that hands out work can now fuel you: Research Station Veil and Triton Wake Lab gained a pump. The two authored fuel-less outposts keep their charted frontier fiction.

A refused jump now answers in player words with the world's own numbers - gate toll vs purse, fuel need vs tank, cooldown seconds - and the chart's success toast asks the world first and names the sector instead of its raw id
Point-defence interceptions publish their true point and produce one designed spark plus one authored positional snap.
Gameplay exposes velocity vectoring On/Off and the profile preserves the chosen boolean while defaulting older profiles On.
towable pilgrimage bell on the Vesta lane that tolls under speed and draws danger — tow/hire/pass/desecrate branches with credit, reputation, and news consequences
Rope material glows with the sim-published tether.strainGlow, so a loaded whip reads before it snaps; slack reads 0
One mining yield plays sfx_mining_yield once; the verb-route impact no longer doubles it.
reel in/out default to BracketLeft/Right in every scheme; held winch drives reelDelta, modal-safe, rebindable

A resolved survivor pod paints one colour for rescue, ransom, or loss at the pod's last point, and the body is gone.

the weaponless detonator dart now publishes its detonation as the detonator_run doctrine's commit action through combat:fire; a duplicated kill receipt can no longer double-publish the commit, and doctrine action/aftermath cues are marked critical so the pop tick's damage noise can no longer starve the resolution beat
An uninsured death names hull insurance and the station premium; an insured death names only the deductible.
hot-dock spill emits one berth-apron cue with the lot count; whitelist resolves it at the berth
target assist has off and strength in Gameplay settings; off is zero correction, full is authored

A re-rated moment raises the grade on the one clip already in the reel; a lower grade leaves that plate alone.
complicationScheduled was a dead audit emit; marketNews now commits one cited foreshadow line per (wreck,timer) before the fire — name without kind, deduped, ordering pinned
The arrival card names the assigned pad, or the hold and how many ships are ahead, and clears the line on undock.
An emergent tool plays its own voice once per event, including the first shot; a weapon-fire cue stays silent.
Help lists every live pad binding, including accept, station tabs, hull burst, and chords, and follows a rebind.
A line rebound plays one twang; strain and a near-break stay on their own voice.
